## Three deployments

| Site | Host | What it serves |
| --- | --- | --- |
| mitoshi.xyz | Cloudflare Worker `mitoshi-web` with static assets, placed in AWS eu-west-1 | The static app, `/relay/*` (sealed messages, public pictures, live feeds), 301s from the old `/docs/*` pages to this site |
| mitoshi-gateway.vercel.app | Vercel Function in `dub1` (Dublin), up to 60 s per call | `/ohttp` for the relay only, `/ohttp-keys` for anyone |
| docs.mitoshi.xyz | Cloudflare Worker `mitoshi-docs`, static assets only | This site |

The relay and the docs Worker have their request logs off (`observability.enabled: false`).

## Every page carries its own policy

A script after each build (`apps/web/scripts/headers.mjs`, and this site's own `apps/docs/scripts/headers.mjs`) hashes
every inline script of every page and writes a header file:

| Header | Value |
| --- | --- |
| `Content-Security-Policy` | `default-src 'self'`, `script-src 'self'` plus that page's SHA-256 hashes (the app adds `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` for the wallet), `connect-src 'self'`, `font-src 'self'`, `img-src 'self' data:` (the app adds `blob:`), `object-src 'none'`, `base-uri 'none'`, `frame-ancestors 'none'` |
| `Cache-Control` | `public, max-age=0, must-revalidate, no-transform` |
| Isolation | COOP `same-origin`, COEP `require-corp`, CORP `same-origin` |
| Others | `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`, `Referrer-Policy: no-referrer`, `X-Frame-Options: DENY`, a `Permissions-Policy` that turns off camera, microphone, location, payment, USB and topics |

**No `unsafe-inline` for scripts, and nothing from another origin.** `no-transform` stops Cloudflare's proxy from
rewriting a page, so it can't inject its analytics beacon or an email-obfuscation script even if one is switched on for
the zone. The 404 page answers every unknown path, so no header rule can name it: it carries the same policy in a
`<meta>` tag.

## Workers can reach only their own origin

Module workers take their CSP from their own response, not from the page. On mitoshi.xyz every file under
`/_next/static/` is served with `default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; connect-src 'self'`, so the
wallet worker and the Polymarket worker can reach mitoshi.xyz and nothing else, even if a library inside them reaches
past the sealed fetch. Only files that exist are cached for a year; a missing chunk is never cached.

## Fonts and pictures

Sora, Inter and JetBrains Mono are downloaded at build time and served from the site itself; 見通し uses a 2.5 KB Noto
Serif JP subset. The app's coin and venue marks are vendored files, so no mark is fetched from a third party at
runtime.
